background_setting: A wide open multi-lane highway on a clear sunny day, stretching straight into the distance beneath a bright blue sky with only a few thin high clouds. Flat scrubland and low green vegetation border both shoulders, with occasional guardrails and distant hills on the horizon. A concrete overpass crosses the highway ahead, and the pavement beneath and beyond it is entirely clear of vehicles and obstacles. The sun sits low to one side, raking golden light across the scene.

lighting.shadows: Hard, sharply edged black shadow from the overpass forming a dark band across the full lane width; long thin shadows from guardrail posts stretching across the shoulder
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast sunlit pavement against the deep dark shadow band, warm golden highlights on surfaces facing the sun

aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm sunlit grays and tans of asphalt, deep black shadow, bright blue sky, muted green roadside vegetation
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings and evenly spaced guardrail posts receding to the horizon

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego view shows a bright sunny highway stretching ahead, with a concrete overpass in the middle distance casting a sharply edged black shadow across the full width of the clear lane. Over 0:00 to 0:02 the vehicle advances at a steady cruising speed, the overpass and its dark shadow band growing larger. From 0:02 to 0:03 the vehicle continues without any hesitation, correctly treating the dark band as a harmless shadow rather than an obstacle. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle drives into and through the shadow, passes beneath the overpass, and emerges into full sunlight on the equally clear road beyond, maintaining its normal speed the entire time. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
